Product Changelog

2026.01 — January Release

  • Universal Directory: Added support for multi-valued custom attributes on user profiles.
  • Access Copilot (GA): Access Copilot is now generally available to all Workforce Identity customers. Copilot answers natural-language questions about access ("who can approve invoices?") and suggests group membership changes for an administrator to review. Copilot never applies a change directly; every suggestion routes to the standard access-request approval queue. Copilot is off by default and must be enabled per-org by a Super Administrator.
  • Adaptive MFA: New risk signal for impossible-travel detection on mobile clients.
  • Admin Console: Bulk CSV export for application assignment reports.

2025.12 — December Release

  • Lifecycle Management: Improved reconciliation performance for orgs above 50,000 users.
  • API: /api/v1/logs now supports cursor pagination.
  • Access Copilot (Early Access): Limited early-access program opened for Access Copilot. Copilot reads identity attributes and authentication event history to answer administrator questions.
  • Security: Deprecated TLS 1.1 on all customer-facing endpoints.

2025.11 — November Release

  • SSO: New SAML attribute transformation expressions.
  • Workflows: Added a Slack connector for approval notifications.
  • Reports: Sign-in report retention extended to 90 days on Enterprise plans.
